full_judgment:
Md. Abdul Matin J.:- This petition for leave to appeal is directed against order dated 14.01.2009 passed by the High Court Division in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 1950 of 2008 issuing Rule with stay and subsequent extension dated 08.04.2009. 

 10. Being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the proceeding and judgment and order of conviction and sentence dated 14.05.2008 passed by the learned Special Judge, Special Court No. 9, Dhaka in Special Case No. 10 of 2008. The petitioner filed Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 1950 of 2009 before the High Court Division and the High Court Division issued the impugned order. 

 19. The impugned order of the High Court Division dated 14th January, 2009 passed in Criminal Miscellaneous Case No. 1950 of 2009 is stayed with direction to the respondent No. 1 to surrender before the concerned Court within 2 (two) weeks.
